adaptive_meta_plan.expected_effect: Hypothesis: the search will spend a slot on a complete proof-qualified resident or measured hot-capacity candidate instead of repeating the parent construct/mutate wording, while the meta decision forces a round-0 rethink. This should produce a selected program distinct from the parent and improve replay-window score over both parent and incumbent if valid resident or backing proof is available.
adaptive_meta_plan.falsification: Falsified if the gate shows no changed task or meta decision on the matched starting archive, if both function ASTs do not change, if the resident proof is invalid, or if the selected candidate fails to lower the training replay score versus the parent and incumbent. Also falsified if the changed evidence order alone causes an invalid family or duplicate decisions.
adaptive_meta_plan.mechanism_change: build_prompt now reverses the selected evidence order, uses even slots for construct guidance that checks qualified resident proof against a safe tiered fallback, and uses odd slots to mutate the last parent at rule 0 toward hot-capacity or backing-mode repair. build_meta_prompt switches round 0 to rethink with reversed evidence and uses revise later, explicitly preserving the best measured training program.
adaptive_meta_plan.observed_problem: The selected training evidence shows the incumbent and native baselines are close tiered/all-host replays with 4096 hot slots and similar cold-miss diagnostics. The parent generator only alternates construct and mutate, always orders evidence the same way, and always uses revise, so it does not push a proof-first comparison of legal backing modes and measured hot capacities after seeing that close result.
